description: This file implements network listeners with keepalive and TLS support for the etcd project, including functions to create and accept keepalive and TLS-enabled network connections.

classes.name: keepaliveListener
classes.description: A listener that wraps another net.Listener to add keepalive functionality.

classes.name: keepAliveConn
classes.description: A wrapper around net.TCPConn to provide keepalive settings.

classes.name: tlsKeepaliveListener
classes.description: A listener that wraps another net.Listener to add TLS support with keepalive.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts incoming connections, wrapping them with keepalive or TLS as appropriate.

methods.name: createKeepaliveConn
methods.description: Creates a keepAliveConn from a net.Conn, ensuring it is a TCP connection.

methods.name: SetKeepAlive
methods.description: Enables or disables TCP keepalive on the connection.

methods.name: newTLSKeepaliveListener
methods.description: Creates a TLS-enabled listener that wraps an existing net.Listener.
